definitions.explanation: The physical right arm of the body.
A person's most trusted and capable assistant or subordinate. Used figuratively, similar to English "right-hand man."

examples.japanese: {右腕|みぎうで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怪我|けが}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{右腕|みぎうで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げた→投げる：01135_nageru⟧。
examples.english: I put all my strength into my right arm and threw the ball.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧がいなくなったら、{右腕|みぎうで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同然|どうぜん}→同然：09487_douzen⟧だ。
examples.english: If he leaves, it will be like losing my right-hand man.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右腕|みぎうで}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えて→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: She has supported the company for many years as the president's right-hand woman.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右腕|みぎうで}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦コーチ→コーチ：03844_koochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: The coach who is called the manager's right-hand man has earned the trust of the players.

notes:
USAGE:
The literal meaning (sense 1) is straightforward. The figurative meaning (sense 2) is very common and describes a person who is indispensable to a leader or organization. The figurative usage often appears with patterns like ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右腕|みぎうで} or {右腕|みぎうで}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右腕|みぎうで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ (to lose one's right-hand man)
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右腕|みぎうで}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as someone's right-hand man)
- {右腕|みぎうで}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to be called someone's right-hand man)
- {右腕|みぎうで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ (to serve as someone's right-hand man)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {右腕|みぎうで}: right-hand man (most trusted person)
- ⟦{片腕|かたうで}→片腕：13509_kataude⟧: one's right hand (figuratively; same meaning as sense 2)
- ⟦{腹心|ふくしん}→腹心：13976_fukushin⟧: confidant (trusted aide, more formal and literary)
- {側近|そっきん}: close aide (often in political contexts)
